name: USDU Finance
oneLiner: USDU is USDU Finance's DAO-minted dollar backed by Curve, Morpho, and TermMax vault shares; the issuer reports ~40% collateralization by design.
collateral: Adapter-held positions: Curve USDU/USDC LP tokens, Morpho USDU Core vault shares (curated lending), and TermMax USDU vault shares (fixed-term lending) as on-chain backing
pegMechanism: Protocol-minted via DAO-approved adapters; convertible to USDC via Curve pools

notices.title: Undercollateralized by design
notices.message: USDU Finance's transparency page currently shows ~40.69% collateralization ($2.06M backing vs $5.06M circulating supply). The protocol is minted through DAO-approved adapters and is intentionally undercollateralized for professional market participants.

notices.title: Conflicting issuer disclosures
notices.message: USDU Finance's own surfaces disagree: the transparency page headline reports ~40.69% CR while a separate JSON endpoint reports ~97% CR and the gitbook says 'fully backed'. Pharos surfaces the public-page headline as the conservative reference; treat collateralization figures as advisory until USDU publishes a single canonical methodology.

mintAuthority.summary: USDU cannot be minted by users directly; only DAO-approved/whitelisted adapter contracts (Curve, TermMax, Morpho) can mint or burn USDU, and the set of approved adapters is curated under USDU Finance DAO risk governance.

controls.label: Whitelisted USDU adapters (Curve / TermMax / Morpho)
controls.evidence: USDU Finance docs/transparency state users cannot mint USDU directly; only whitelisted adapters can mint/burn USDU while executing their strategy, with each adapter holding the on-chain backing assets.

controls.label: USDU DAO / curator (adapter whitelist authority)
controls.evidence: The DAO/curator governs adapter approval and risk parameters, controlling which contracts hold mint/burn rights; published as core token/DAO/adapter contracts on Ethereum.

review.evidence: USDU Finance transparency and docs describe a restricted mint model where only DAO-approved adapter contracts (Curve, TermMax, Morpho) mint/burn USDU and users cannot mint directly; the adapter whitelist is set by the DAO/curator. USDU Core was audited by BlockBite (July 2025).
review.sourceFreeRationale: Adapter-only mint and DAO-curated whitelist taken from USDU's transparency/docs surfaces; the specific DAO/curator and adapter contract addresses and any timelock were not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain DAO/curator address (EOA, multisig, or governor) and the adapter MINTER_ROLE grants and any timelock.
